stableInstruction: An adult woman speaking English with clearly recognizable Kenyan English pronunciation and cadence, East African English vowel shaping, even syllable rhythm and clean consonant release. Her individual voice has a distinctly high natural soprano register. Its timbre is balanced, warm and clear, with balanced natural resonance; it is distinctly gravelly but still natural, clear with little breathiness, with minimal habitual creak. Use a slightly brisk conversational pace. Maintain this individual vocal identity. Speak naturally without caricature, shouting, or added vocal events.
